```{r}
#| label: setup

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggtext, glue, here, fs, patchwork, install = FALSE)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                axis.text = element_blank(),
                axis.title = element_blank()))
```

## Generate VAE Architecture Diagram

```{r}
#| label: fig-vae-viz
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7

# Define coordinates for the network layers
layers <- tibble(
  name = c("Adjusted\nmeth", "E1\n512", "E2\n256", "E3\n128", "E4\n64", 
           "z_mean\n(6)", "z_log_var\n(6)", "z\n(Latent)",
           "D1\n64", "D2\n128", "D3\n256", "D4\n512", "Reconstructed\nmeth"),
  x = c(0, 1.5, 3, 4.5, 6, 
        8, 8, 10,
        12, 13.5, 15, 16.5, 18),
  y = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
        0.5, -0.5, 0,
        0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  width = c(1.4, 1.2, 1.1, 1, 0.9,
            1.2, 1.2, 1,
            0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.4),
  height = c(3, 2.5, 2.0, 1.5, 1.0,
             0.6, 0.6, 1.5,
             1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3),
  type = c("Data", "Encoder", "Encoder", "Encoder", "Encoder",
           "Latent", "Latent", "Latent",
           "Decoder", "Decoder", "Decoder", "Decoder", "Data")
)

# Connections (arrows)
connections <- tibble(
  x = c(0.7, 2.1, 3.55, 5, 6.45, 6.45, 8.6, 8.6, 10.5, 12.45, 14, 15.55, 17.3),
  xend = c(0.9, 2.4, 3.95, 5.5, 7.4, 7.4, 9.5, 9.5, 11.55, 13.05, 14.45, 15.95, 17.5),
  y = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.5, -0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  yend = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0.4, -0.4, 0.1, -0.1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
)

# Define colors consistent with publications
colors <- c(
  "Data" = "#f5f5f5",
  "Encoder" = "#e3f2fd",
  "Latent" = "#f3e5f5",
  "Decoder" = "#fff3e0"
)

border_colors <- c(
  "Data" = "#9e9e9e",
  "Encoder" = "#1e88e5",
  "Latent" = "#8e24aa",
  "Decoder" = "#fb8c00"
)

# Build the plot
p_arch <- ggplot() +
  # Draw connections
  geom_segment(data = connections, aes(x=x, y=y, xend=xend, yend=yend), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "grey40") +
  # Draw layers as rects
  geom_tile(data = layers, aes(x=x, y=y, width=width, height=height, fill=type, color=type), 
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Add labels inside layers
  geom_text(data = layers, aes(x=x, y=y, label=name), size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9) +
  # Label the subgraphs
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 2.4, label = "INPUT", fontface = "bold", color = "#9e9e9e", size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.75, y = 2.4, label = "ENCODER\n(4 layers)", fontface = "bold", color = "#1e88e5", size = 4.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 9, y = 2.4, label = "PROBABILISTIC\nLATENT", fontface = "bold", color = "#8e24aa", size = 4.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 14.25, y = 2.4, label = "DECODER\n(4 layers)", fontface = "bold", color = "#fb8c00", size = 4.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 2.4, label = "OUTPUT", fontface = "bold", color = "#9e9e9e", size = 4.5) +
  # Add parameters text boxes
  annotate("richtext", x = 3.75, y = -2.2, label = "BN + ReLU<br>Dropout (0.05–0.1)",
           fill = "white", label.color = NA, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("richtext", x = 9, y = -2.2, label = "6D Latent Space<br>Beta = 0.001", 
           fill = "white", label.color = NA, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("richtext", x = 14.25, y = -2.2, label = "BN + ReLU<br>Dropout (0.05–0.1)",
           fill = "white", label.color = NA, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = border_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) + # Reduced expansion
  coord_equal(clip = "off") + 
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  theme_void()

# Legend refinement: tighter spacing
legend_data <- tibble(
  x = c(3, 7, 11, 15),
  y = 0,
  label = c("Data Input/Output", "Encoder Layers", "Latent Variables", "Decoder Layers"),
  type = c("Data", "Encoder", "Latent", "Decoder")
)

p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data) +
  geom_tile(aes(x=x, y=y, width=1.4, height=0.7, fill=type, color=type), linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x=x, y=y-0.6, label=label), size=3.5, fontface="bold") + # Reduced y offset
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = border_colors) +
  xlim(0, 18) + ylim(-1.0, 0.7) + # Tightened ylim
  theme_void() +
  guides(fill="none", color="none")

# Combine with patchwork - modified heights
final_plot <- p_arch / p_legend + plot_layout(heights = c(6, 1))

# Save
fs::dir_create(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output"))
ggsave(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_architecture_pub.png"), final_plot, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_architecture_pub.pdf"), final_plot, width = 12, height = 7, bg = "white")
write_rds(final_plot, here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_architecture_pub.rds"))
print(final_plot)
```
